CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)
New Delhi, the 24th July, 2026
The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from 24th July, 2026 Shri
Ravneet Singh relinquished the charge of the office of the Minister of State in the
Ministry of Food Processing Industries; and Minister of State in the Ministry of
Railways.
